name: Ghost
description: Publishing platform for blogs and newsletters with paid members

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The MySQL database (posts, members, settings), content/ with your images, themes and files, and state/secrets.env, this install's own passwords made on first start. Back it up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Ghost site, admin (/ghost) and mail viewer (/mail), published on host as 6752

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: Required. Replace YOUR-SERVER-IP with your server IP, like http://192.168.1.20:6752. Ghost puts this address in every link and email. For a public blog, use your domain, like https://blog.example.com.
